senses.gloss: --worms of the earth; 1/१००० of vegetable kingdom and also watery. वा. १०१. १९८.
--a hell, to which go those that hate their fathers, ब्राह्मणस् and Gods and those who speak ill of gems. Vi. II. 6. 3 and १५. [page१-481+ ३०]
--a hell, to which go those that practise magic art. Vi. II. 6. 3 and १५.
(I)--a daughter of Kardama married to Kratu. Mother of 6,००० Va1lakhilyas. भा. III. २४. २३; IV. 1. ३९.

(II)--a daughter of दक्ष, and a wife of Dharma; mother of Yoga and of Manus;
1: भा. IV. 1. ४९ and ५१; Br. IV. 1. २४.
also of Naya, दण्ड (Dama-ब्र्। प्।) and Samaya (शम-ब्र्। प्।), (Vinaya- वि। प्।).
2: Br. II. 9. ४९, ६०; वा. १०. २५, ३५; ५५. ४३; Vi. I. 7. २३ and २९.
(IV)--a R. from the ऋक्ष hills. Br. II. १६. २९.
--rituals described. Br. IV. ४३. 8 to the end.

--a form of active worship of Hari;
1: भा. XII. ११. 3; M. 1. 3; ५२. 7-११. २७-28.
Brahman becomes नारायण thereby; incumbent on householders; no ज्ञानम् without कर्म; consists of 8 आत्मगुणस्; is dharma.
2: M. १३४. १७-18; १४५. २७-28; २५८. 1-3.
--love sports of Gandharvas and Apsaras, described. M. १२१. 1-३०. [page१-482+ २८]
